self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Lone Light's Blessing: for 14s after using an Elemental Skill, ATK is increased by between 36% and 72%, re-evaluated each second from how far the wielder moved in the preceding second. Pick the state matching the assumed movement: a stationary rotation sits at the 36% floor, constant repositioning reaches the 72% ceiling. Removed when the wielder leaves the field, so this is a main-slot buff only.

source.note: 7.0 weapon, added 2026-08-08 from nanoka 6.7.54 beta data (neither Amber nor GO carry it yet). Base stats derived as init x levels['90'] + last ascension add, the same derivation validated to the cent against 15 existing seed files. Buffs baked at R5 (house convention: 4* at R5, 5* at R1).

en.flavor: He drew this weapon once more when he first met that God of Flame, revered by all, but it had been too long since he had last used it.

refinements.1: After the equipping character uses their Elemental Skill, they gain "Gleam of First Light." While active, Gleam of First Light tracks their distance traveled. Each second, the equipping character gains an ATK Bonus ranging from <r>18%</r> to <r>36%</r> based on the distance traveled during the previous second. Gleam of First Light lasts 14s, can be triggered once every 14s, and is removed when the equipping character leaves the field.

fr.flavor: Une arme inutilisée depuis longtemps qu'il a ressortie lorsqu'il a aperçu ce dieu des flammes à qui tout le monde avait souhaité du bien la première fois.

refinements.1: Déclencher une compétence élémentaire accorde l'effet Première Lueur au personnage équipé de l'arme : augmente chaque seconde son ATQ d'une valeur comprise entre <r>18 %</r> et <r>36 %</r> selon la distance qu'il a parcourue pendant la seconde qui vient de s'écouler. Cet effet dure 14 s, peut être déclenché une fois toutes les 14 s et s'annule lorsque le personnage équipé de l'arme quitte le champ de bataille.
